title: GET /pub/v1/usage/summary response
description: Per-assignment budget readout for the current UTC day. Spent is the builtin cost_micros sum of today's usage events; BYOK traffic never counts (owner does not pay for user keys).

project.description: Project slug this summary is bound to.

day.description: UTC day (YYYY-MM-DD) the spend is aggregated over.

unassigned_spent_micros.description: Builtin spend of the day not attributable to a current assignment (rows reported without an assignment, or one since replaced).

spent_micros.description: Builtin cost_micros summed over the UTC day for this assignment.

daily_budget_micros.description: Configured daily budget; null when the assignment has none (no enforcement).

percent.description: spent/limit as a percent, rounded to 2 decimals; null when the budget is unset or zero.
